decision.reason: The two evidence excerpts [ev-2875a348b5d7] (v1.20.1) and [ev-59d22c21eec4] (v2.0.0) only contain "/*", so they show nothing about the flag. The computed diff shows just one thing: a deprecation log line saying the --enable-composition-functions-extra-resources flag "will be removed in a future release" was deleted. It does not show whether the flag's definition was removed in v2.0.0. It also does not show what happens to an environment that still passes the flag: whether startup is rejected as an unknown flag, the flag is silently ignored, or it is still accepted. To decide the consequence we need the flag-definition diff in core.go, or a release note or upgrade-guide entry about the flag's removal.
